mechanism: Both drugs can cause hypotension and tachycardia; atomoxetine inhibits CYP2D6 which may slightly increase sildenafil levels, and both have sympathomimetic and vasodilatory effects that may compound cardiovascular stress.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; use with caution in patients with cardiovascular disease; counsel on additive hypotensive effects and avoid concurrent use if possible in high-risk patients.
